_doc: Zone 2 Kreis 5 (Auftrag Z2B). Squares that places_detail*.json did not cover and whose OSM plaza polygon is drawn as default cobble: ground classified from SWISSIMAGE 0.5 m (lawn / gravel / paved). No objects without photo evidence (Escher-Wyss-Platz: the only photos in data/raw/photos/z2 show the Hardbruecke deck from a car, no platform detail). Escher-Wyss buckets, Josefwiese, Limmatplatz, Hardplatz fountains: places_detail_<id>.json converts the WVZ fountains; the duplicate catalog troughs are excluded in catalog_assign.json (_z2).

places.src: SWISSIMAGE 0.5 m (ortho_ground); OSM Technoparkstrasse surface=asphalt/concrete, footway concrete; audit_ground.py --zone 2
